pages.name: home-dark
pages.after: (async () => { for (let i=0;i<30 && !document.getElementById('verified-suppliers');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const h=document.getElementById('verified-suppliers'); const vp=document.querySelector('[data-testid=value-proposition]'); const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('section[aria-labelledby=verified-suppliers] a')]; if(h) h.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return { heading: h && h.textContent, valueProp: vp && vp.textContent, cards: cards.length, firstHref: cards[0] && cards[0].getAttribute('href'), cardOverflow: cards.filter(c=>c.scrollWidth>c.clientWidth+1).length, rawKeys: /home\.[a-zA-Z]+/.test(document.body.innerText) }; })()
